recentItems.title: Starlink Vs Reliance: Elon Musk Says Ready To Connect India With High-Speed Internet
recentItems.description:
Elon Musk’s Starlink says it is ready to connect India with high-speed satellite internet, responding to Reliance Industries amid growing competition in the satellite communications sector. Starlink claims it has spent over five years working with Indian regulators, industry players and operators and has built dedicated infrastructure with the requisite government approvals. Reliance has welcomed competition but insists that all companies must comply with Indian laws and policies. Could Starlink emerge as a new rival in India’s internet market? Here’s what the latest exchange means for Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance, Jio and India’s satellite internet future.
